# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 25 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 25 | **Condition:** very fragmentary

---

**25:1** [...] for [...] my heart [...] has trembled at Your judgments [...]

**25:2** [...] and my inner being is undone, and my bones are broken apart [...]

**25:3** [...] and my heart pours out like water, and my flesh melts like wax [...]

**25:4** [...] and my knees buckle like water spilled upon a slope [...]

**25:5** [...] and I said: In my transgression I am forsaken [...]

**25:6** [...] from Your covenant. But when I recalled the power of Your hand [...]

**25:7** [...] together with the abundance of Your mercies, I stood upright and rose [...]

**25:8** [...] and my spirit held fast to its station, for I relied [...]

**25:9** [...] upon Your covenant faithfulness, and the abundance of Your mercies [...]

**25:10** [...] for You atone for transgression, and You cleanse a person from guilt through Your righteousness [...]

**25:11** [...] and [...] my strength [...] has faltered before Your glory [...]

**25:12** [...] and there is no remnant, and no strength [...] remains in me [...]

**25:13** [...] I am struck silent, for what shall I speak that is not already known [...]

**25:14** [...] and what shall I declare that has not been told? All things [...]

**25:15** [...] are inscribed before You with the stylus of remembrance for all the appointed times [...]

**25:16** [...] of eternity, and the cycles of the years everlasting [...]

**25:17** [...] in all their appointed seasons, and they shall not be concealed [...]

**25:18** [...] from before You. How shall a mortal recount his transgression? [...]

**25:19** [...] and how shall he plead concerning his iniquity? [...]

**25:20** [...] and how shall he answer to righteous judgment? [...]

**25:21** [...] To You, O God of knowledge, belong all the works of righteousness [...]

**25:22** [...] and the counsel of truth; but to the children of mortals belongs the service of iniquity [...]

**25:23** [...] and the works of deceit. You created breath for the tongue [...]

**25:24** [...] and You know its words, and You ordained the fruit of the lips [...]

**25:25** [...] before they came to be. And You set words upon a measuring line [...]

**25:26** [...] and the utterance of the breath of the lips by measure [...]

**25:27** [...] and You bring forth sounds according to their mysteries [...]

**25:28** [...] and the outpourings of breath according to their reckoning, to make known [...]

**25:29** [...] Your glory and to recount Your wonders [...]

**25:30** [...] but Your mercies [...] have sustained me through all these things [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows LOGOS for this fragmentary column. The somatic lament sequence (25:1-4) is among the most vivid in the Hodayot. "Covenant faithfulness" for chesed per project convention. PNEUMA's "faithful love" rejected. The divine-speech passage (25:23-28) required minimal adjudication as all three translators preserved the essential meaning. See disagreement log.*
